description: Use BEFORE performing any high-risk action the user has flagged (budget changes, prod deploys, payments, mass communications). Sends a push to the user's phone with a Face ID + Number Matching prompt. By default (wait_for_decision=true) blocks until they decide or the wait runs out (status 'timeout'). With wait_for_decision=false it returns immediately with status 'pending' — then poll logi__check_approval with the SAME auth_req_id. ONLY status 'approved' means proceed; anything else (pending, delivered, timeout, rejected, expired, revoked) means DO NOT proceed — abort and report. One approval covers exactly one execution of the described action: NEVER reuse it for another or repeated action. This tool cannot create an approval by itself — only the human on their phone can. When retrying the same request after an error, pass the same idempotency_key (1-255 printable ASCII characters, no leading/trailing spaces) so the user is not prompted twice. If waiting fails after the request was created, the error still carries the auth_req_id — check or cancel it, never assume approval. NEVER bypass.
name: logi__request_approval
